name: Map Buddy: Find and Make Maps

ios.desc:
Map Buddy™ lets you discover, subscribe, and create interactive maps.

Use it to find food trucks, garage sales, good coffee, and more! Plan your next friendly scavenger hunt or leave surprise notes for your loved ones.

Maps that you subscribe to are visible on your home map. Map Buddy is your one stop place to view all of the things that you find interesting in a single place.

Map Buddy comes with a curated list of automatically updated maps. This includes Earthquakes and data sourced from San Francisco municipal sources, such as 311, 911, and fire department calls. More curated maps are added constantly!

The Great Lakes Bay Region Alliance uses Map Buddy to host their STEM Passport program and to promote partnered STEM locations with Michigan students.

Note that Radar Chat has been renamed to Map Buddy! The functionality of the app hasn’t changed much: you can still use Map Buddy to leave digital messages attached to physical locations. However, we feel the new name better conveys the utility that people have found with the app, not to mention “Radar Chat” never really gave users the ability to “chat”.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Map Buddy: Discover, subscribe, and create interactive maps

quotes.text:
Map Buddy was built to make it easy to map ephemeral events that just aren't a good fit for other map apps. For example: Garage Sales, roaming Food Trucks, and the locations of vendors and water stations at outdoor music festivals.

The long term goal is for most of the maps to be created by the community. That said, to fix the chicken-and-egg problem, there are several automated first-party maps that contain fun data. For example, there are maps for San Francisco police, Fire Department, and 311 calls, and Earthquake epicenters from all around the world.

If all this information were to always be visible then the user would certainly be overwhelmed! They would also see a lot of stuff they just don't care about. Instead, Map Buddy users subscribe to the maps they care about, and their home map is a composite of all of these maps. This means you might see coffee shops, Dreamforce after parties, and Burning Man art, while your friend might see coffee shops, the local chamber of commerce members, and doggy bag stations.

Map Buddy is available as a mobile-friendly web app, iOS app, and Android app:

* Web: https://app.mapbuddy.app/

* iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/radar-chat-local-discovery/id1599975217

* Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=chat.radar.app.twa
